scope: 法宝、术法、材料与丹药宝箱
presentation: 玄青玉色与金线边框，独立术法图纹，属性前后对照，桌面三列与手机纵向长卡

rules.statProjection: Stat and equipment apply functions accept an explicit player copy. Preview constrains the copy using current cultivation caps without mutating combat or saves.
rules.spellProjection: Counts, circle distributions, ranges, pulses, shields, healing and base damage use SpellGrowth.spec directly.
rules.chestPersistence: The first receipt stores comparison rows in the existing chest reward envelope before applying the reward. Reload shows the saved comparison without granting it again.
rules.legacy: Already-applied older chest rewards retain their existing effects; unavailable prior values are never invented.
rules.ration: Projected ration effects share the same applyCamp implementation as actual travel.
rules.damageDisplay: Spell base damage excludes character damage multipliers and critical strikes, as labelled on cards.

examples.attribute: 三昧真火作用半径 Lv.12 → 13

interaction: 长卡可纵向滚动，末项可点击
收起遮挡卡面的战斗按钮和短字幕
减少动态效果的系统偏好生效

validation.limits: Mobile checks use desktop browser viewport sizes; no physical-device performance claim.

publish.cache: Build uses the deployed Git revision in script and stylesheet URLs.
